explanation: The theorem is about the library's own constructions: the Frobenius truncation ideal, socle, tangentMatrix, linearPart and linearSubst, in the quotient of MvPolynomial σ K by the ideal generated by p-th powers. It says that the product of the (f i)^(p-1) equals det(Jacobian)^(p-1) times the socle generator. It is proved from library-specific lemmas (top_product_eq_linear, linearSubst_socle). Mathlib has no declaration for truncated polynomial rings with a socle or tangent matrix. The content lies in the library's own definitions, so I did not search further and found no matching Mathlib declaration.
